assertion.text: The Lean 4 theorem `Erdos828.erdos_828.variants.phi_dvd_self_iff_pow2_pow3` is proven and kernel-verified (axioms: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; no sorryAx): for n : ℕ, Euler's totient φ(n) divides n if and only if n ≤ 1 or n = 2^a · 3^b for some a > 0 and b ≥ 0. Closes a previously-open `sorry` (category: textbook) in google-deepmind/formal-conjectures Erdős Problem 828.
